extDescription.message: Translate selected text in place as you browse — long selections too. Uses Google Translate.

actionTitle.message:
Quick Translator

Click to translate!
Right-click for options.

popupTurnedOff.message: Pop-up turned off. You can turn it back on in the options.

whenSelect.message: When I select a word or phrase:

modeIcon.message: Show an icon I can click to open the pop-up.

modeNone.message: Don't show an icon or pop-up.

modePopupTip.message: Selected text is sent to Google's translation servers to be translated.

modeNoneTip.message: You can still translate selected text with the toolbar icon or the right-click menu.

alwaysShowIcon.message: Show the icon even if the page is already in my language.

errorFetch.message: Couldn't get the translation. Check your network connection.

errorRateLimit.message: Google is temporarily limiting requests. Please try again in a moment.

errorReload.message: The extension was updated. Please reload this page.

errorEmpty.message: Type or paste some text to translate.

analyticsTip.message: Helps improve the extension. Only anonymous counts are sent via Google Analytics (e.g. which features are used, languages, text length range) — never the text you translate, the translations or the pages you visit.
